            vsurv=x['v']*(1-cV); rsurv=x['r']*(1-cS)
            cash += vsurv*x['va'] + rsurv*x['ra']
            x['r']=rsurv+vsurv  # survivors join rest pool (tested); avg price approx blends
            if x['r']>0: x['ra']=(rsurv*x['ra']+vsurv*x['va'])/x['r']
            x['v']=0
        da=d-DAY
        if da in (7,28,84,182): out[da]=cash
    fsub=sum(x['v']+x['r'] for x in bk.values())
    print('%-22s cV=%.2f cSw=%.3f cSb=%.3f trim=%s  +7d=$%.0f +28d=$%.0f +84d=$%.0f +182d=$%.0f (endsub=%d)'%(
        label,cV,cS_wave,cS_base,trim,out[7],out[28],out[84],out[182],fsub))
    return out

import novamind_api as nm
day = nm.vars.current_day; tm = day % 30
# Classify each sub: vulnerable = tenure 95-128d AND last bill was BEFORE cascade (d171) = untested newish 4th-bill cohort
# last bill day for mod30 b = day - ((tm - b) % 30)
r = nm.query("""SELECT billing_day_mod30 b, (189-start_day) ten, COUNT(*) n, SUM(effective_price) g
  FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY b, (189-start_day)""")
# Aggregate into pools per bucket
buckets = {}  # b -> {'vuln_n','vuln_g','rest_n','rest_g'}
for x in r['rows']:
    b=x['b']; ten=x['ten']; n=x['n']; g=x['g'] or 0
    lastbill = day - ((tm - b) % 30)
    untested = lastbill < 171   # billed before cascade d171-174
    newish = 95 <= ten <= 128
    vuln = untested and newish
    d = buckets.setdefault(b, {'vuln_n':0,'vuln_g':0.0,'rest_n':0,'rest_g':0.0})
    if vuln: d['vuln_n']+=n; d['vuln_g']+=g
    else: d['rest_n']+=n; d['rest_g']+=g
tot_v = sum(d['vuln_n'] for d in buckets.values())
tot_r = sum(d['rest_n'] for d in buckets.values())
print(f"day {day} mod30={tm}. TOTAL vulnerable(untested newish 4th-bill)={tot_v}, rest={tot_r}, base={tot_v+tot_r}")
# Show by next-bill week
for wk,off in [('wk28',1),('wk29',8),('wk30',15),('wk31',22)]:
    bks=[(tm+off+i)%30 for i in range(7)]
    v=sum(buckets.get(b,{}).get('vuln_n',0) for b in bks)
    rr=sum(buckets.get(b,{}).get('rest_n',0) for b in bks)
    vg=sum(buckets.get(b,{}).get('vuln_g',0) for b in bks)
    rg=sum(buckets.get(b,{}).get('rest_g',0) for b in bks)
    print(f"  {wk} (mod30 {bks[0]}-{bks[-1]}): vuln={v} (${vg:,.0f}) rest={rr} (${rg:,.0f})")
# Dump per-bucket for sim
import json
out={str(b):buckets[b] for b in sorted(buckets)}
with open('pools.json','w') as f: json.dump({'tm':tm,'day':day,'buckets':out},f)
